page.layout: Two columns of a Hebrew lexicon, left and right, on one printed page. Left column: entries from "ויצלנו" to "ויצפהו" and onward. Right column: entries from "ויצץ" to "ויצקם". No marginal notes. Below the right column: catchword "fut." at the right, and signature "Z 2" at the left.

main_text.l: ויצלנו et eripuit nos, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. (יצל, vel יצל,) aff. R. נצל
ויצם & jejunavit, יצמו jejunabunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. צום.
ויצע stratum erat, præt. Pual, 3. f. m. vel pro יצעו sternetur, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. יצע
יצע stratum, pro יצע, No. f. m. R. יצע
ויצעק & convocavit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יצעק
ויצעקו & convocatisunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. יצעק
יצף speculabitur, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. (pro יצפה,) Rad. צפה
ויצף et fluere fecit, fut. Hiph, 3. f. m. R. צוף
ויצף et speculatus est, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. apoc. (pro יצפה,) Rad. צפה
ויצפהו et speculatus est eum יצפהו, ויצפו eos, et, speculati sunt, fut. Pi-
el, 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. Rad. צפה
ויצץ et floruit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יצץ
ויצק et effudit, 1 Reg. 22. 35. (quasi pro ויצק,) fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. יצק
יצק effunde, Imper. Kal, f. m. R. יצק
יצק effundet, pro יצק, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. יצק
ויצקו et statuerunt, (pro יצקו,) fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. Rad. יצק, vel potiùs ob Dagesch. à Rad. יצק.
ויצקו et effundite (vel) et effundent, Imper. Kal, pl. m. vel fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. pro יצקו. R. יצק
יצקות fusæ, part. Pahul Kal, pl. fæm. Rad. יצק
יצקים fusi, Paul Kal, vel No. part. pl. m. R. יצק
ויצקם et effuderunt eos, fut.

page.notes: The Hebrew forms are read from a small, speckled scan and many vowel points and consonants are uncertain; they are not checked letter by letter, so treat all Hebrew as provisional. The running head is a Hebrew letter (tsade) repeated on both sides and is marked as doubtful. Catchword "fut." and signature "Z 2" are read at the foot of the right column.
